name: intelligent-empty-state
title: Intelligent Empty State
description: A blank workspace that actually evolves instead of staying blank forever, driven by a real visit count and real click counts kept in this browser, not a scripted slideshow: visit one highlights a single guided action with a pulsing halo, visits two through four recap exactly what you did last time, and visit five on promotes whichever action you've actually clicked most into a one-tap sparkle shortcut. A "simulate next visit" control lets you fast-forward through all three tiers in one sitting.
